deadline.value: Apply by 1 December 2026 for September 2027 entry (same date for international applicants).
deadline.quote: September 2027 | International Applicants | Application Deadline1 December 2026

gre_subject.value: No GRE (General or Physics Subject) is required.

supervisor.value: No prior commitment is needed, but contact potential advisers in the fall before applying.
supervisor.quote: No commitment from a supervisor prior to applying is necessary, but contacting faculty members is encouraged. | Please contact potential PhD adviser in the fall before you have submitted your application.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student gets at least CAD 40,000 a year for the first four years (from September 2026).
funding.quote: All full-time students in UBC-Vancouver PhD programs will be provided with a funding package of at least $40,000 for each of the first four years of their PhD from September 2026.

entry_route.value: Normally admitted after an MSc; strong UBC MSc students can transfer to the PhD after a year.
entry_route.quote: Students are normally admitted to the Ph.D. program after obtaining an M.Sc. and meeting the Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies admission requirements.

gre_general.quote: The requirements for this program are: | The GRE is not required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90 overall (old 120-point scale) or 4.5 on the new 6-point scale; section minimums apply.
toefl_min.quote: 120-point scale for tests taken prior to Jan 21, 2026 | Overall score requirement: 90

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with section minimums.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: International English Language Testing System (Academic) | Overall score requirement: 6.5

notes: Separate PhD listing from Physics, same department.
